offers.title: Offer Analyzer
offers.subtitle: Enter an offer as it comes in — the breakdown updates instantly.

howCalculated.title: How this was calculated
howCalculated.totalMiles: Total miles = delivery miles + return miles
howCalculated.totalTime: Total time = estimated time + extra wait time
howCalculated.vehicleCost: Vehicle cost = total miles × your vehicle's cost per mile
howCalculated.grossPerMile: Gross per mile = payout ÷ total miles
howCalculated.netPerMile: Net per mile = estimated net ÷ total miles
howCalculated.grossPerHour: Gross per hour = payout ÷ total hours
howCalculated.netPerHour: Net per hour = estimated net ÷ total hours
